messages:
cole: Alert — planned global routing failover rehearsal tonight 00:30 UTC. Window ~40m. Purpose: exercise smart routing fallbacks and per-tenant routing policies. Low impact expected.

maya: Summary: we'll simulate a partial region outage in us-west by cordoning cluster and routing traffic to us-east & eu-central for 20m. Also validate per-tenant tiered fallback (dedicated->shared).

tess: Canary: 00:10 start 1% synthetic with mixed short/long gen. 00:25 ramp to 5% if stable. I'll run prefix-cache validation at 00:20.

cole: Runbook excerpt:
```
- 00:05 pause non-critical batch jobs
- 00:10 start 1% canary (traffic-shaper)
- 00:25 ramp to 5% if no regressions
- 00:30 cordon/evict us-west control-plane sim
- 00:35 observe p95/p99, 5xx, routing-override metrics
- 00:50 revert cordon and failback
```

maya: SLO update: temporary annotation and soft-relaxation of latency SLO p99 99.9% -> 99.6% for the rehearsal window. We'll record in SLO system.

oncall-bot: scheduled-maintenance created: id mnt-1822, start 1786452600, end 1786455000 — see /maint mnt-1822

tess: Alerts to watch: `routing-fallback-rate`, `tenant-fallback-count`, `edge-5xx-rate`, `model-kv-cache-hit`. I'll add a short-term pager: page if fallback-rate > 2% for 3m.

cole: Warmup command after cordon:
```
for i in {1..150}; do curl -sS "$CANARY_URL/warm?model=small_quant" >/dev/null; done
```

maya: Risk notes: tenants with pinned dedicated pools may see brief throttling when switching to shared pools. No API key rotation. Notify CS if any enterprise tenants require heads-up.

tess: I'll be on standby 00:00-01:00 UTC. Ping me if canary shows >1% 5xx. :raised_hands:

cole: Please ack if you have region-pinned services. I'll post a postmortem template in this thread after the rehearsal.

maya: ack

tess: ack

cole: Prechecks starting in 20m, will update with canary metrics.
